experiment_data.hypothesis: FewNERD temperature ablation (T=0.8): test how moderate-low temperature affects degeneracy rate and SC diagnostic cascade on FewNERD, complementing SciERC T-ablation data. N=8, Qwen3-8B-FT, seed=42. T=0.8 is a sweet-spot candidate balancing diversity and quality.

spec.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python -u code/run_mvp_pilot.py --model_path checkpoints/qwen3-8b-fewnerd-exp021-merged --data_dir data/fewnerd/ --dataset fewnerd --subtask ner --n_samples 8 --temperature 0.8 --seed 42 --collect_logprobs --output_dir output/fewnerd_t08_s42/

experiment_data.notes: T=0.8 confirms sweet-spot hypothesis on FewNERD: best rho_SJ_F1=0.206 (full), 0.225 (conditional), lowest degeneracy (19%), highest sample quality (mean F1=0.662). SJ beats Fleiss by 0.102 rho advantage. Logprob baseline rho=0.232 (full) surprisingly high — SJ diagnostic matches logprob informativeness at this T. Verdict FAIL only because MVP single-subtask threshold not met, but T=0.8 is clearly the best operating point.
